title: NCIS: New Orleans

description:

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

Painful memories come flooding back when a gruesome copycat murder leads to the reopening of a case for Wade.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

Pride's longtime friend, state and military attorney Rita Devereaux, asks NCIS to investigate the disappearance of a JAG lawyer who specializes in classified cases and volunteers at a private military academy.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

A highly skilled special operations Marine assaults six men in a bar, sending the NCIS team on a city-wide manhunt.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

Tammy is reunited with her ex-husband, Ethan McKinley - who embezzled millions in Katrina relief funds - after he's tied to the murder of a crime boss' son.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

A deadly accident at a naval base exposes a unit of Seabees to a super virus and leaves the rest of the base and the city of New Orleans at risk for an outbreak; Wade is infected with the virus and given hours to live.

description:

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

The murder of a Navy chaplain leads Pride to uncover a possible connection between Mayor Hamilton and illegal activity taking place in the city of Clearwater; Percy continues to face repercussions of her choices on a previous case.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

When Pride is spotted tracking one of Mayor Hamilton's accomplices on a crowded street, the suspect opens fire, putting innocent lives at risk before disappearing.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E24 — Poetic Justice
Unable to trust anyone in New Orleans, the NCIS team calls in FBI Assistant Director Isler to help expose and stop Mayor Hamilton's sinister scheme.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

While Pride remains on probation after his rogue takedown of the corrupt Mayor Hamilton, his team is closely monitored by a strict supervisor; the team must secretly investigate after the FBI takes the lead on a case involving stolen nuclear waste.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E02 — No. 1 Fan
An erratic whistleblower who calls Pride her mentor kidnaps him to help her locate a serial killer targeting young women in the Gulf of Mexico.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

The team reopens a cold case when a stolen Navy-issue gun turns out to belong to a chief petty officer who died 40 years ago; the team makes their annual Thanksgiving dinner together.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

A Marine's murder reveals new clues in the first case LaSalle and Pride worked together; a Thanksgiving celebration at Pride's bar.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

The team joins forces with FBI Director Isler after a Russian operative with intelligence on sleeper agents disappears; Tammy partners with former sleeper agent Eva Azarova to assist in the disappearance.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

The team investigates the copycat murder of an unsolved case from 150 years ago that spawned a legendary ghost story; Gregorio is spooked when the case is connected to a recent séance and a local medium.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

Sebastian is placed on administrative leave after being questioned by the FBI about a foot chase; Pride and the team attempt to clear Sebastian's name.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

The murder of a petty officer leads the team to a woman who is targeting men with high security clearance; LaSalle's father arrives to discuss the family business.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:

title: Bull
description:

Bull helps a professional video game player, who has been accused of intentionally losing a championship game, sue his former team owner for defamation.

title: Bull
description:

title: Bull
description:

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:

description:

After tracking down the missing uranium, which has been used to build a bomb in the middle of the jungle, McGarrett and Danny must move the explosive material through treacherous terrain before it detonates.

description:

description:

description:

description:

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:

At Halloween, the team investigates a string of murders that mirrors stories from well-known Hawaiian folklore; Grover visits a man who is hours away from execution and may hold the key to a case that has plagued Grover for years.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:

The murder of two tourists leads the team to a man who has multiple personality disorder; Danny and the others hire a stress management consultant to help McGarrett.

McGarrett poses as a pilot to investigate a plane crash that led to the death of a pilot in an air race.

description:

McGarrett, Danny, Tani, and Junior are exposed to a deadly biological weapon; the rest of the team has eight hours to find an antidote.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:

Danny is shot while quarantined in the hospital; unconscious, he clings to life and imagines a future for everyone.

Benny's previous career with the district attorney's office comes into focus when Chunk aims to get a new trial for a man he believes was wrongfully convicted of triple homicide by a prosecution team that included Benny.

Taylor becomes personally invested in having Bull help a dancer bring a civil suit against a real estate mogul who assaulted her at a gentlemen's club when the district attorney's office refuses to pursue criminal charges.

A woman who has a reputation for aggressive behavior is on trial for her husband's murder, but she claims to have no memory of it due to an alcohol-induced blackout.

Bull faces the seemingly impossible task of defending a client who already confessed to accidentally killing the doctor he blames for his mother's death.
